text:
devon: Anyone know where the per-GPU SM% time series for prod-gpu-pool-2 lives? Trying to correlate with sudden batch-size spikes this morning. The grafana link I had 404'd. Need KV cache hitrate and per-node memory series too.
ara: Use the gpu-overview dashboard (grafana.redwoodinternal/d/8f3gH/gpu-overview). Panels: 'SM Utilization by GPU', 'KVCache Hitrate', and 'GPU Memory by Node'. The link probably rotated.
ara: PromQL samples if useful:
```
avg by (gpu) (rate(sm_utilization[5m]))
sum by (node) (kvcache_hit_count) / sum by (node) (kvcache_req_count)
avg by (node) (gpu_memory_used_bytes / gpu_memory_total_bytes)
```
devon: Thanks! Do we have a quick way to get per-model batch size percentiles (95th)? Want to see if a few models are causing the spikes.
ara: We keep batch_size histograms in metrics. Try this for 95th per model:
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(batch_size_bucket[5m])) by (le, model))
```
ara: There's a hidden panel on the per-model dashboard but query above works for ad-hoc.
matt: Quick note: we're seeing OOM-like retries when SM > 85% and mem > 90% for ~3m. Current alert is 95% for 5m, which is too late. @ara can we relax that to ~88% for prod-gpu-pool-2 only?
ara: Yeah, lowering to 88% for that pool makes sense as an early warning. Opened infra ticket to scope rule to pool and adjust thresholds.
infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-1234: 'gpu: lower SM% alert for prod-gpu-pool-2 to 88% / 3m, add mem condition' (assigned to oncall).
jen: I'll pick up the PR to change the alerting rule and add the mem condition + rollout plan. Assign to me, please.
devon: Thanks Jen. Can you also add a note in the ticket with the grafana panel ids and the PromQL snippets above?
jen: yup, adding now. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/456 (WIP).
deploybot: infra PR 456 passed CI and was queued for canary deploy.
matt: After change, can we run a 24h backtest on last week's spikes to ensure no noisy alerts?
ara: I'll run a quick alert-sim with the new thresholds and post results here by EOD.
devon: If alert noise looks ok, can we also add a small dashboard panel for batch-size 95/99 per-model so product teams can self-serve?
jen: Agree. I'll add a new panel to the per-model dashboard in the PR.
devon: Awesome. Thanks all :thumbsup:
ara: Posting trace link for one of the spikes: https://tracing.redwoodinternal/trace/0a1b2c3d (shows long queueing + KV miss bursts)
jen: Updated PR with rule changes and panel json snippet. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/456
matt: LGTM on rule logic, would prefer 88/3m for pool and keep 95/5m global as a hard alert.
jen: Done. Merging after canary pass.
deploybot: Canary deploy complete, alert rule change rolled to prod-gpu-pool-2 canary.
devon: Verified panel metrics look stable after rule change. Will follow up with 24h results. Thanks team!
